# The Headless Horse

The Headless Horse is Equestria's spooky **ghost-story horse** in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic* (G4), most recognizable as the headless silhouette that chases Scootaloo in a nightmare. It has a tall, very dark blue, mare-shaped body, a flowing indigo-edged tail, and no visible head. Its existence as a real creature in the television continuity is **unconfirmed**: the visible pursuit happens in a dream.

[![The Headless Horse rearing against the moon — *Sleepless in Ponyville* television still](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2020/7/20/1742588/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/1742588)

*Image: production still from* Friendship Is Magic, *credited to the Hasbro television production; the linked archive post identifies the episode.*

**Name and continuity.** “The Headless Horse” is the **on-screen name**, not a fan nickname: Twilight introduces *The Legend of the Headless Horse* in “Look Before You Sleep” ([episode dialogue](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Look_Before_You_Sleep)). The licensed mobile game lists a character as simply **Headless Horse** and uses it as a boss helper ([game character record](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Headless_Horse)); that game depiction does not establish that the nightmare creature physically exists in the television story. The figure's mare-like design and a feminine reference in a guidebook explain its grouping with mares, although the show usually uses neutral language ([character overview](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/The_Headless_Horse)).

**Speaking and other appearances.** The creature **has no dialogue or identified voice actor**. Beyond the S1 story and S3 dream, Rarity briefly considers a “headless pony” costume in “Scare Master” (S5E21; [episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Scare_Master)). A book called *The Headless Horse* also appears in the IDW mini-comic *The Fall of Sunset Shimmer*. **Princess Luna is not a confirmed alternate identity**: Scootaloo mistakes Luna for the monster, and Luna corrects her ([dream dialogue](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Sleepless_in_Ponyville)).

## Important moments

1. **Twilight's slumber-party scare — “Look Before You Sleep” (S1E8).** Twilight tells the legend to Rarity and Applejack, delivering its name as a jump scare; this establishes the Equestrian folklore. [Verified full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oGck5MKWrKI) — exact scene timestamp unavailable.
2. **Rainbow's forest warning — “Sleepless in Ponyville” (S3E6).** Rainbow Dash describes the headless horse hunting lost ponies, terrifying Scootaloo despite Applejack's questions about its anatomy. [Verified full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FkSzs6KERmU) — exact scene timestamp unavailable.
3. **The nightmare and Luna — “Sleepless in Ponyville” (S3E6).** Scootaloo is chased by the silhouette, but Luna's intervention reveals that her deeper fear is disappointing Rainbow Dash. [Episode account](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Sleepless_in_Ponyville) — exact scene timestamp unavailable.
4. **The “wicked whinny” — “Sleepless in Ponyville” (S3E6).** Mistaking Rainbow's snoring for the monster, Scootaloo runs into real danger; Rainbow rescues her, and their sister-like bond begins. Same verified full episode above; exact scene timestamp unavailable.
